description: This file defines the FooTable.Column class, which manages properties and behaviors of table columns in the FooTable plugin, including initialization, parsing, formatting, and cell creation.

classes.name: F.Column
classes.description: Class representing a table column with properties like type, visibility, style, and methods for parsing, formatting, and creating cells.

methods.name: construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the column with instance, definition, and type.

methods.name: define
methods.description: Defines column properties based on the provided definition object.

methods.name: $create
methods.description: Creates or updates the jQuery element for the column header.

methods.name: parser
methods.description: Parses a cell value or element to extract data.

methods.name: formatter
methods.description: Formats a value for display in a cell.

methods.name: createCell
methods.description: Creates a cell object for a given row.
